product_metadata.title: Flyowl Boot Tray for Entryway Indoor, 2 Pack 24 x 16 inch Heavy Duty Shoe Mat for All Weather, Use to Store Shoes&Boot, Pets' Feeder, Plants, Tools.
features: 【Shoe Tray】- 2 packs, 23.6” L x 15.7” W x 1.2” H shoe tray large. Great for snowy & rainy days to store muddy shoes and wet umbrella, Keep your carpet & floors nice and clean. This tray can easily accommodate 2 pairs of adult shoes + 1 pair of children's shoe. You can contact us if you have any questions during receipt and use.

【Environmently Friendly】- The plastic shoe tray for entryway indoor is made of 100% recycled polypropylene plastic. This plastic tray has excellent abrasion resistance and durability, so there is no need to worry about the deformation during the using. The bottom of the tray is designed with a diamond-shaped raised pattern that helps to drain moisture from the boots for faster drying.
【Multi-use Boot Tray】- Our shoe mat tray can be used to store boot, shoes, plants, tools, pets' bowls, feeder, car trunks and kitchen storage. Perfect for storing gardening or pet supplies too.

【Easy to Clean】- This boot mat tray is non-slip and easy to clean. A little stain just need to rinse with water and towel dry to restore clean. When there are stubborn stains can be soaked in water and then cleaned with a brush or soft cloth, rinse and wipe dry.

【Great for Storage】- The wet shoe mats has a 1.2-inch raised edge, which not only enhances structural strength and makes the shoe mat stronger, but also effectively prevents spills of pet food, rainwater, muddy, plant slurry and staining of the floor.
